Locale.title: See your ideas in this language

Fresh.title: Offers are included in your ideas
Fresh.body: Matching offers from your chosen stores can give suitable dishes a little extra priority. Your family’s preferences still come first.

NoMatch.title: Good ideas, even without a matching offer
NoMatch.body: We checked your stores, but found no suitable offer match for these ideas. They’re still based on your family’s preferences.

Partial.title: Your ideas are ready to use
Partial.body: Offer matching is incomplete, so some savings may be missing. Your family’s preferences still guide the ideas below.

Unavailable.title: Meal ideas without offers for now
Unavailable.body: We couldn’t get usable offers from your stores. You can still plan with ideas based on your family’s preferences.

Stale.title: These offers need a fresh check
Stale.body: Some offer information is older or has expired. Refresh ideas before relying on the prices; your saved meal plan is unchanged.

Disabled.title: Ideas based on your family
Disabled.body: Grocery offers aren’t active right now. Your family’s preferences still guide your meal ideas.

NoStores.title: Add offers from the stores you use
NoStores.body: Your ideas already use your family’s preferences. Choose stores in family settings if you’d like matching offers included too.

Unknown.title: Your meal ideas are still here
Unknown.body: We don’t have a confirmed offer status for these ideas. Use them for planning, but don’t rely on offer prices yet.
